postgresql_version: PostgreSQL 18.4 (Debian 18.4-1.pgdg13+1) on aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 14.2.0-19) 14.2.0, 64-bit

cases.name: view
cases.setup: CREATE TEMP VIEW named_input AS SELECT n FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) input(n);
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) SELECT n FROM named_input

cases.name: nested_view
cases.setup: CREATE TEMP VIEW named_input AS SELECT n FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) input(n);CREATE TEMP VIEW named_outer AS SELECT n FROM named_input LIMIT 2;
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING FALSE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT n FROM named_outer

cases.name: folded_cte
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING FALSE, FORMAT JSON) WITH input AS NOT MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) SELECT * FROM input

cases.name: lexical_view_cte
cases.setup: CREATE TEMP VIEW named_input AS WITH input AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) SELECT * FROM input;
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING FALSE, FORMAT JSON) WITH input AS MATERIALIZED (VALUES (9)) SELECT * FROM named_input

cases.name: unexecuted_effect
cases.setup: CREATE TEMP SEQUENCE named_effect; CREATE TEMP VIEW named_input AS SELECT n, nextval('named_effect') AS effect FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) input(n);
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) SELECT effect FROM named_input

cases.name: executed_effect
cases.setup: CREATE TEMP SEQUENCE named_effect; CREATE TEMP VIEW named_input AS SELECT n, nextval('named_effect') AS effect FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) input(n);
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING FALSE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT effect FROM named_input

cases.name: unused_volatile_output
cases.setup: CREATE TEMP SEQUENCE named_effect; CREATE TEMP VIEW named_input AS SELECT n, nextval('named_effect') AS effect FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) input(n);
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING FALSE, FORMAT JSON) SELECT n FROM named_input

cases.name: prepared_view
cases.setup: CREATE TEMP VIEW named_input AS SELECT n FROM (VALUES (1),(2),(3)) input(n);PREPARE named_statement(integer) AS SELECT n FROM named_input LIMIT $1;
cases.sql: EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING FALSE, FORMAT JSON) EXECUTE named_statement(2)
